payload.title: India's Performance at the 2026 Asian Games

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: One source states India won 80 medals at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, comprising 18 gold, 26 silver and 36 bronze, and that India are fifth in the standings [E1][E4]; another source states India won 85 medals at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, including 21 gold, 27 silver and 37 bronze, finishing fourth overall [E5][E7]. One source reports India have won 80 medals at the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, comprising 18 gold, 26 silver and 36 bronze [E1]; another reports India have won 85 medals at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, including 21 gold, 27 silver and 37 bronze, finishing fourth overall [E5]. Notable first-time medals for India included Jay Meena's soft tennis medal [E17], Suchika Tariyal's MMA medal [E18], and the women's skeet team's first medal in that event [E19]. As of September 23, 2026, the interim tally stood at 12 medals (1 gold, 5 silver, 6 bronze) [E20].

sections.heading: Concepts
sections.body: One source states India have won 80 medals at the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, comprising 18 gold, 26 silver and 36 bronze [E1] and that India are fifth in the standings [E4]; another states India have won 85 medals at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, including 21 gold, 27 silver and 37 bronze, finishing fourth overall [E5], with a standings table showing India fourth with 21 gold, 27 silver, 37 bronze, 85 total [E7]. The discipline-wise breakdown shows athletics produced 24 medals, including one gold, nine silver and 14 bronze; shooting contributed 15 medals; archery finished with nine medals [E8].

sections.heading: Examples
sections.body: Athletics contributed 24 medals (1 gold, 9 silver, 14 bronze), shooting 15 medals (3 gold, 8 silver, 4 bronze), and archery 9 medals (5 gold, 2 silver, 2 bronze) to India's tally [E8]. Historic firsts included a soft tennis medal by Jay Meena [E17], an MMA medal by Suchika Tariyal [E18], and a women's skeet team medal [E19].
